historical_inputs.json.projection: species input triples only; witness paths omitted

candidate_rule: All reaction targets without an exact/pool match to the bounded historical input union. Molecular holdout previews additionally require a resolved absent broad family and no unresolved candidate aliases. No outcome magnitude, prediction or residual selects candidates.
heldout_rule: For each candidate, exclude its target, exact/pool-equivalent equations, all reaction and formation targets involving held-out broad families, and every unresolved training row. Broad families ignore stereochemistry for conservative exclusion; this is not a scaffold holdout.
distance_scope: Morgan radius2/2048bits/chirality on explicit pool keys, evaluated after declared training exclusions. Original concrete-domain neighbours are also reported to expose effects of removing unresolved rows. No native released-model novelty or uncertainty claim.
source_matching: Case, whitespace, primitive rational extent and direction only. Named equations retain phase and stereochemical text. Matches remain ancestry leads, never verified label derivations.
benchmark_design: state_function_validation/design.json remains authoritative; no gates or success thresholds changed.
historical_exposure_scope: Bounded reaction-shaped JSON inventory only, not an exhaustive audit of old scripts, molecular records, notebooks, spreadsheets or private outcomes. Absence is not independence.
comparator_controls_required: Use the same conservative unresolved-row exclusions in nested controls.
Use training-only scaling/normalization and source-pinned training settings.
Hold out source/measurement duplicates and all held-out-family formation labels.
Control for training-support loss; do not compare a reduced retraining corpus as if it were the native full-corpus model.
Use the native100-member ensemble for a native-uncertainty comparison; five-member or CV-repeat spread is a different estimator.
A confidence interval spanning zero is inconclusive, not evidence of equivalence.

input_sources.public671: Local reviewed copy tools/dGbyG/dGbyG/data/TrainingData.csv, SHA256 pinned above. Exact upstream training/checkpoint correspondence remains unverified; repository https://github.com/f-wc/dGbyG is attribution, not a verified snapshot URL.
